Thomas Ku

3rd year mechanical engineering student seeking a Spring/Summer internship in manufacturing, CAD, mechanical, thermal or electrical engineering

I am a third-year mechanical engineering student at Rutgers University seeking a Spring/Summer internship in manufacturing, CAD, mechanical, thermal or electrical engineering. For CAD and mechanical roles, I build full SolidWorks assemblies, run fit and interference checks, and help my HPVC team choose materials, transmission and wheels. For manufacturing, I produce GD&T drawings that cut fabrication errors, use root cause analysis and FMEA, and have MIG welded and assembled suspension parts on the Baja Car Team. For thermal work, I bring coursework in thermodynamics and mechanics of materials. For electrical work, I program Arduino and ESP32 boards and have wired motor drivers, sensors and a dimmer circuit in my own projects.
